subject.title: [Bug]: In msteams channel messages, OpenClaw can't access inbound attachments

question: Should Microsoft Teams non-personal Graph media fallback be automatic when no media is extracted, or default-off behind `channels.msteams.graphMediaFallback` while the channel URL/thread fixes land?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but the fallback default changes existing deployments through Graph call volume, permission expectations, diagnostics, and the earlier mention-only false-positive protection.

options.title: Default-off opt-in fallback
options.body: Adopt the config-gated shape so existing installs keep current mention-only behavior unless operators explicitly enable extra Graph message reads for attachment recovery.

options.title: Automatic non-personal fallback
options.body: Relax the gate for non-personal HTML activities with no media so attachments work without new config, accepting extra Graph reads and possible mention-only noise.

options.title: Combine the fix candidates
options.body: Ask one branch to cover channel aadGroupId, reply URL selection, and group-chat fallback policy so the compatibility story lands once.

recommendation.title: Default-off opt-in fallback
recommendation.body: Adopt the config-gated shape so existing installs keep current mention-only behavior unless operators explicitly enable extra Graph message reads for attachment recovery.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal spans the msteams plugin boundary and central attachment files, and the remaining question is an upgrade/product default choice.
